Data Analyst
Love turning raw data into sharp business insights?
We are looking for a Data Analyst with a strong technical foundation in Python
and SQL to join a specialist team in central Auckland. This role is for someone
who enjoys the intersection of statistical methodology and data analytics,
moving beyond basic reporting to execute complex analyses and maintain
robust data workflows.
You'll join a team that values habitual curiosity and high-quality technical
output, using analytical scripts to translate datasets into clear, actionable
narratives. While there is a specialized geospatial component, the core of this
role is about technical ownership, automation, and applying statistical thinking
to drive business decisions. This is an ideal next step for an experienced
analyst who thrives on blending mathematical rigour with creative storytelling.
You will:

JD example

7


Deliver High-Quality Products: Work collaboratively to support the delivery
of customer data insights and geospatial analytics on time and to customer
requirements.
Deep Dive into Data: Analyze datasets to identify trends and patterns using
statistical methods and modeling to support critical business decisions.
Code & Automate: Use Python and SQL to assist in producing analytics
outputs, with a focus on turning manual processes into scalable, automated
workflows.
Visualize & Storytell: Assist in creating templated and bespoke reports,
dashboards, and visualizations that turn complex data into actionable
narratives.
Maintain Data Integrity: Help maintain best-practice data quality, security,
and the currency of essential datasets like census and spatial data.
Collaborate Regionally: Work with internal teams to ensure analytics
outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with broader business goals.

What's in it for you?
Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values being curious, being
awesome (not average) and puts "Passion in Play".
Innovation-Led Environment: Exposure to leading-edge projects, including
the building of an AI-powered analytics platform and advanced geospatial
modeling.
Growth & Impact: A role where you can build deep expertise in data
analytics and geospatial methods while seeing your insights drive real
value.

You'll bring:
Experience: At least 3 years in a data analysis role, preferably with
exposure to customer insights or geospatial intelligence.
Technical Literacy: Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Excel, with the ability to
write and maintain analytical scripts.
Mathematical Mindset: A solid understanding of statistical methodologies

JD example

8


Communication Skills: The ability to explain findings and recommended
actions effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Education: A BSc/BA in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Management, or
a related field.

Bonus points for:
Experience with Esri (ArcGIS suite) or similar mapping applications.
A proactive, problem-solving mindset and a willingness to contribute ideas
to improve standard products.
Ready to bring data to life and shape insights that matter?
